Comment.MultiLanguageText: This block reads diagnostic information (control inputs and outputs) of a Motorstarter. At runtime, this block is enabled when the ET200SP Motorstarter screen is shown in the HMI. Based on the selected motorstarter object in the HMI by the user. The shown information in the HMI depends on the Unit and Cotrol Module selected.

LineComment.Text: working with static values to keep the last selected value when opening for the first time the screen
